    • namedGroups

      public HttpTokenRequester.Builder namedGroups(String... namedGroups)
      TLS named groups (key exchange groups) for HTTPS requests, e.g. X25519MLKEM768 for post-quantum key exchange.

      Requires sslContext(SSLContext) to be set, and Java 20 or more.

      Parameters:
      namedGroups - the named groups, in order of preference
      Returns:
      this builder

    • connectionConfigurator

      public HttpTokenRequester.Builder connectionConfigurator(Consumer<HttpURLConnection> connectionConfigurator)
      Sets a configurator applied to the connection after all library defaults (timeouts, headers, Authorization) have been set. The configurator runs last and may override any of them.
